case.title: The Missing Professor
case.tagline: A light still burns in a laboratory that should be empty.
case.story: Professor Elias Verma has not been seen since Thursday night. His coat hangs in Lab 4, his tea is cold, and the research files for his cancer-drug formula are gone. The campus has three people who had access after hours. Find out who took the professor, and why.

suspect.name: Dr. Meera Rao
suspect.profile: Competed with Verma for the same grant for six years.

suspect.name: Karan Malhotra
suspect.profile: Quiet, deep in debt, with keys to every lab.

suspect.name: Dean Sharma
suspect.profile: Had threatened to cut Verma's funding.

location.name: Laboratory 4
location.desc: Steel benches, a humming fridge and an open logbook.

location.name: Faculty Office
location.desc: Paper everywhere. The bin hasn't been emptied.

location.name: Security Desk
location.desc: Keycard readers log every door on campus.

motives.motive: Selling the formula to a rival firm

clue.title: Lab logbook
clue.text: Verma's last entry is 9:40 PM: "K. asked for the formula files again. Refused."

clue.title: Torn courier receipt
clue.text: A receipt addressed to Helix Biotech, signed with the initials K.M.

clue.title: Keycard log
clue.text: Karan Malhotra's card opened Lab 4 at 11:52 PM, after the building was locked.

clue.title: Safe contents
clue.text: A USB drive label: "Backup, copied by K." The files were duplicated before they vanished.

clue.title: Corridor CCTV
clue.text: A lab-coated figure leaves at 11:58 PM carrying a black case. The hands are those of a young man.

clue.title: Deleted file history
clue.text: The formula was emailed out from Karan's account at 11:55 PM.

solution.explanation: Karan owed money and tried to buy Verma's files for Helix Biotech. After Verma refused, Karan returned at 11:52 PM, copied the formula and emailed it at 11:55 PM. The courier receipt and the keycard log place him there, and the sent email proves intent.

case.title: Murder at Midnight
case.tagline: A storm, a locked manor and a dead man in his study.
case.story: Lord Ashcombe was found dead in the study of Blackwood Manor just after midnight. The storm has cut the roads, so the killer is still in the house. Three guests had reason to want him gone, and one of them is lying.

suspect.name: Lady Vivian Ashcombe
suspect.profile: Estranged, but still named in the will.

suspect.name: Mr. Graves
suspect.profile: Thirty years of loyal service, and a locked drawer nobody has seen inside.

suspect.name: Dr. Pell
suspect.profile: Attending Lord Ashcombe's heart condition for a decade.

location.name: The Study
location.desc: A toppled chair, a smashed glass and a mantel clock.

location.name: Dining Room
location.desc: The table is still set. One wine glass is untouched.

location.name: Guest Room
location.desc: Dr. Pell's room, his leather bag on the bed.

clue.title: Stopped clock
clue.text: The mantel clock stopped at 11:47 when it was knocked from the shelf.

clue.title: Poisoned glass
clue.text: Traces of digitalis, a heart drug that is deadly in overdose, in the wine glass.

clue.title: Pell's bag
clue.text: An empty digitalis vial is missing from the doctor's bag, with its label torn off.

clue.title: Study safe ledger
clue.text: The ledger lists dozens of prescriptions signed by Dr. Pell for patients who do not exist. Ashcombe had circled them.

clue.title: Muddy footprints
clue.text: Boot prints by the garden door match Dr. Pell's shoes, not the butler's.

clue.title: Garden-door footprints
clue.text: Wet prints lead in from the garden door and stop at the study.

solution.explanation: Lord Ashcombe discovered Dr. Pell's fake prescriptions and circled them in the ledger. Pell poisoned the wine with digitalis from his own bag, then went out through the garden door to look as if he came from the guest wing. The glass, the missing vial and the ledger together show means, opportunity and motive.
